en: A monochrome panoramic view of a European town set in rolling countryside. In the middle distance are dense rows of houses and larger public buildings, with a prominent church featuring a tall central tower and spire. Smokestacks and factory buildings dot the right side, suggesting early industrialization. In the foreground are fenced fields, trees lining a road, piles of stone, and a small wooden shed. The lower margin contains printed red text identifying the town as Warnsdorf i. B. and the publisher information with a date.
